description: Concurrent Force Reporter, step 2. For a set of items (elements, nodes, links), finds the load state that makes ONE key effect extreme at ONE key item (max, min or absolute max over the selected load cases and combinations, at every output point), then reports every item's results IN THAT SAME STATE — the coexistent forces a bearing, pier cap or connection check needs, not each item's own envelope. If the governing load is an envelope (or an Add containing one), it is resolved recursively to a single deterministic state (a weighted sum of static/stage cases, pinning each envelope to the child that governs at the key item), re-read at that state, and gated against the value MIDAS itself reports; it refuses rather than approximates. Near-ties are reported. Items: items in set syntax — elements 12 or 15to20, nodes N12, general links L12, elastic links EL12 (a range keeps only ids that exist) — and/or structure groups. keyItem must be in the set. Values come back in the units asked for (default the model's); plate results are per unit length. Read-only (only /post/TABLE result reads). Call concurrent_forces_setup first for names and keyEffect ids. Runs as a job on the website.

csv.description: Also store the full table (header, notes, every row) as a CSV file and return its link.

groups.description: Structure groups to add to the set.

include.description: elements, nodes, both, links (general/elastic links with an end on the group's nodes) or all.

items.description: Items in set syntax, e.g. "101to148, N9001to9006, EL12".

keyEffect.description: The governing component: a keyEffect id from setup (e.g. BEAM:Moment-y, REACTION:FZ), or just the component (Moment-y, FZ, Axial) for the key item's own table. Default: the first component of the key item's table.

keyItem.description: The item whose extreme picks the state, e.g. "101", "N9001", "EL12". Must be in the set.

loadCases.description: Load case / combination names to search (available ones from setup).

maxRows.description: At most this many table rows inline.

position.description: Which output points to SHOW for I/J members; the governing state is always searched over all of them.

stageSteps.description: Stage step tokens (from setup) when construction-stage cases are selected. Default: every stage step.

units.description: Units to report in (MIDAS converts). Default: the model's own.

name: concurrent_forces
title: Concurrent forces at the governing state
